items.title: Anthropic is hiding its best AI: Fable 5.2 and the IPO
items.summary: Anthropic just released Claude Fable 5.2, the new number one AI model in the world, and its own system card says it isn't the company's most powerful model. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what Fable 5.2 can do, why Anthropic is holding back a better model, the race with OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and the new IPO terms.
